verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: Fast approaching is the reckoning for the people, but they are oblivious, averse.
verse_text_arabic: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: iq'taraba lilnnāsi ḥisābuhum wahum fī ghaflatin muʿ'riḍūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: اقترب للناس حسابهم وهم فى غفلة معرضون

verse_text_english: When a proof comes to them from their Lord, that is new, they listen to it heedlessly.
verse_text_arabic: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: mā yatīhim min dhik'rin min rabbihim muḥ'dathin illā is'tamaʿūhu wahum yalʿabūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما يأتيهم من ذكر من ربهم محدث إلا استمعوه وهم يلعبون

verse_text_english: Their minds are heedless. And the transgressors confer secretly: "Is he not just a human being like you? Would you accept the magic that is presented to you?"*
verse_text_arabic: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lāhiyatan qulūbuhum wa-asarrū l-najwā alladhīna ẓalamū hal hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum afatatūna l-siḥ'ra wa-antum tub'ṣirūn
verse_footnote_english: *21:3 Although the Bible (Malachi 3:1) and the Quran (3:81) prophesy the advent of God's Messenger of the Covenant, when he did appear, supported by 'one of the greatest miracles' (74:30-35), he was met with heedlessness and opposition. The divine assertion that every 'new' proof is opposed has been proven by the Arabs' opposition to the Quran's miracle. (App. 1 & 2).
verse_text_arabic_clean: لاهية قلوبهم وأسروا النجوى الذين ظلموا هل هذا إلا بشر مثلكم أفتأتون السحر وأنتم تبصرون

verse_text_english: He said, "My Lord knows every thought in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbī yaʿlamu l-qawla fī l-samāi wal-arḍi wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال ربى يعلم القول فى السماء والأرض وهو السميع العليم

verse_text_english: They even said, "Hallucinations," "He made it up," and, "He is a poet. Let him show us a miracle like those of the previous messengers."
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: bal qālū aḍghāthu aḥlāmin bali if'tarāhu bal huwa shāʿirun falyatinā biāyatin kamā ur'sila l-awalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل قالوا أضغث أحلم بل افترىه بل هو شاعر فليأتنا بـٔاية كما أرسل الأولون

verse_text_english: We never annihilated a believing community in the past. Are these people believers?
verse_text_arabic: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: mā āmanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknāhā afahum yu'minūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما ءامنت قبلهم من قرية أهلكنها أفهم يؤمنون

verse_text_english: We did not send before you except men whom we inspired. Ask those who know the scripture, if you do not know.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā arsalnā qablaka illā rijālan nūḥī ilayhim fasalū ahla l-dhik'ri in kuntum lā taʿlamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أرسلنا قبلك إلا رجالا نوحى إليهم فسـٔلوا أهل الذكر إن كنتم لا تعلمون

verse_text_english: We did not give them bodies that did not eat, nor were they immortal.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰلِدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā jaʿalnāhum jasadan lā yakulūna l-ṭaʿāma wamā kānū khālidīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما جعلنهم جسدا لا يأكلون الطعام وما كانوا خلدين

verse_text_english: We fulfilled our promise to them; we saved them together with whomever we willed, and annihilated the transgressors.
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma ṣadaqnāhumu l-waʿda fa-anjaynāhum waman nashāu wa-ahlaknā l-mus'rifīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم صدقنهم الوعد فأنجينهم ومن نشاء وأهلكنا المسرفين

verse_text_english: We have sent down to you a scripture containing your message. Do you not understand?
verse_text_arabic: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَٰبًا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: laqad anzalnā ilaykum kitāban fīhi dhik'rukum afalā taʿqilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لقد أنزلنا إليكم كتبا فيه ذكركم أفلا تعقلون

verse_text_english: Many a community we terminated because of their transgression, and we substituted other people in their place.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wakam qaṣamnā min qaryatin kānat ẓālimatan wa-anshanā baʿdahā qawman ākharīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكم قصمنا من قرية كانت ظالمة وأنشأنا بعدها قوما ءاخرين

verse_text_english: When our requital came to pass, they started to run.
verse_text_arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: falammā aḥassū basanā idhā hum min'hā yarkuḍūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فلما أحسوا بأسنا إذا هم منها يركضون

verse_text_english: Do not run, and come back to your luxuries and your mansions, for you must be held accountable.
verse_text_arabic: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lā tarkuḍū wa-ir'jiʿū ilā mā ut'rif'tum fīhi wamasākinikum laʿallakum tus'alūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا تركضوا وارجعوا إلى ما أترفتم فيه ومسكنكم لعلكم تسـٔلون

verse_text_english: They said, "Woe to us. We were really wicked."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū yāwaylanā innā kunnā ẓālimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا يويلنا إنا كنا ظلمين

verse_text_english: This continued to be their proclamation, until we completely wiped them out.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَٰمِدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: famā zālat til'ka daʿwāhum ḥattā jaʿalnāhum ḥaṣīdan khāmidīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فما زالت تلك دعوىهم حتى جعلنهم حصيدا خمدين

verse_text_english: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them just for amusement.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā khalaqnā l-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما خلقنا السماء والأرض وما بينهما لعبين

verse_text_english: If we needed amusement, we could have initiated it without any of this, if that is what we wanted to do.
verse_text_arabic: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: law aradnā an nattakhidha lahwan la-ittakhadhnāhu min ladunnā in kunnā fāʿilīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لو أردنا أن نتخذ لهوا لاتخذنه من لدنا إن كنا فعلين

verse_text_english: Instead, it is our plan to support the truth against falsehood, in order to defeat it. Woe to you for the utterances you utter.
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: bal naqdhifu bil-ḥaqi ʿalā l-bāṭili fayadmaghuhu fa-idhā huwa zāhiqun walakumu l-waylu mimmā taṣifūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل نقذف بالحق على البطل فيدمغه فإذا هو زاهق ولكم الويل مما تصفون

verse_text_english: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth, and those at Him are never too arrogant to worship Him, nor do they ever waver.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walahu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi waman ʿindahu lā yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatihi walā yastaḥsirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وله من فى السموت والأرض ومن عنده لا يستكبرون عن عبادته ولا يستحسرون

verse_text_english: They glorify night and day, without ever tiring.
verse_text_arabic: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yusabbiḥūna al-layla wal-nahāra lā yafturūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يسبحون اليل والنهار لا يفترون

verse_text_english: Have they found gods on earth who can create?
verse_text_arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: ami ittakhadhū ālihatan mina l-arḍi hum yunshirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم اتخذوا ءالهة من الأرض هم ينشرون

verse_text_english: If there were in them (the heavens and the earth) other gods beside GOD, there would have been chaos. Glory be to GOD; the Lord with absolute authority. He is high above their claims.
verse_text_arabic: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: law kāna fīhimā ālihatun illā l-lahu lafasadatā fasub'ḥāna l-lahi rabbi l-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لو كان فيهما ءالهة إلا الله لفسدتا فسبحن الله رب العرش عما يصفون

verse_text_english: He is never to be asked about anything He does, while all others are questioned.
verse_text_arabic: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lā yus'alu ʿammā yafʿalu wahum yus'alūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يسـٔل عما يفعل وهم يسـٔلون

verse_text_english: Have they found other gods beside Him? Say, "Show me your proof. This is the message to my generation, consummating all previous messages." Indeed, most of them do not recognize the truth; this is why they are so hostile.
verse_text_arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ هَٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: ami ittakhadhū min dūnihi ālihatan qul hātū bur'hānakum hādhā dhik'ru man maʿiya wadhik'ru man qablī bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna l-ḥaqa fahum muʿ'riḍūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم اتخذوا من دونه ءالهة قل هاتوا برهنكم هذا ذكر من معى وذكر من قبلى بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون الحق فهم معرضون

verse_text_english: We did not send any messenger before you except with the inspiration: "There is no god except Me; you shall worship Me alone."
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā arsalnā min qablika min rasūlin illā nūḥī ilayhi annahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-uʿ'budūn
verse_subtitle_english: One God / One Message / One Religion
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أرسلنا من قبلك من رسول إلا نوحى إليه أنه لا إله إلا أنا فاعبدون

verse_text_english: Yet, they said, "The Most Gracious has begotten a son!" Glory be to Him. All (messengers) are (His) honored servants.
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū ittakhadha l-raḥmānu waladan sub'ḥānahu bal ʿibādun muk'ramūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا اتخذ الرحمن ولدا سبحنه بل عباد مكرمون

verse_text_english: They never speak on their own, and they strictly follow His commands.
verse_text_arabic: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lā yasbiqūnahu bil-qawli wahum bi-amrihi yaʿmalūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يسبقونه بالقول وهم بأمره يعملون

verse_text_english: He knows their future and their past. They do not intercede, except for those already accepted by Him, and they are worried about their own necks.*
verse_text_arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yashfaʿūna illā limani ir'taḍā wahum min khashyatihi mush'fiqūn
verse_footnote_english: *21:28 The myth of intercession is Satan's most effective bait (see Appendix 8).
verse_text_arabic_clean: يعلم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم ولا يشفعون إلا لمن ارتضى وهم من خشيته مشفقون

verse_text_english: If any of them claims to be a god beside Him, we requite him with Hell; we thus requite the wicked.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: waman yaqul min'hum innī ilāhun min dūnihi fadhālika najzīhi jahannama kadhālika najzī l-ẓālimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن يقل منهم إنى إله من دونه فذلك نجزيه جهنم كذلك نجزى الظلمين

verse_text_english: Do the unbelievers not realize that the heaven and the earth used to be one solid mass that we exploded into existence? And from water we made all living things. Would they believe?
verse_text_arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَٰهُمَا وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: awalam yara alladhīna kafarū anna l-samāwāti wal-arḍa kānatā ratqan fafataqnāhumā wajaʿalnā mina l-māi kulla shayin ḥayyin afalā yu'minūn
verse_footnote_english: *21:30 The Big Bang Theory is now supported by the Creator's infallible mathematical code (Appendix 1). Thus, it is no longer a theory; it is a law, a proven fact.
verse_text_arabic_clean: أولم ير الذين كفروا أن السموت والأرض كانتا رتقا ففتقنهما وجعلنا من الماء كل شىء حى أفلا يؤمنون

verse_text_english: And we placed on earth stabilizers, lest it tumbles with them, and we placed straight roads therein, that they may be guided.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿalnā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bihim wajaʿalnā fīhā fijājan subulan laʿallahum yahtadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعلنا فى الأرض روسى أن تميد بهم وجعلنا فيها فجاجا سبلا لعلهم يهتدون

verse_text_english: And we rendered the sky a guarded ceiling. Yet, they are totally oblivious to all the portents therein.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوظًا وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿalnā l-samāa saqfan maḥfūẓan wahum ʿan āyātihā muʿ'riḍūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعلنا السماء سقفا محفوظا وهم عن ءايتها معرضون

verse_text_english: And He is the One who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; each floating in its own orbit.
verse_text_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wahuwa alladhī khalaqa al-layla wal-nahāra wal-shamsa wal-qamara kullun fī falakin yasbaḥūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهو الذى خلق اليل والنهار والشمس والقمر كل فى فلك يسبحون

verse_text_english: We never decreed immortality for anyone before you; should you die, are they immortal?
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā jaʿalnā libasharin min qablika l-khul'da afa-in mitta fahumu l-khālidūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما جعلنا لبشر من قبلك الخلد أفإين مت فهم الخلدون

verse_text_english: Every soul will taste death, after we put you to the test through adversity and prosperity, then to us you ultimately return.
verse_text_arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: kullu nafsin dhāiqatu l-mawti wanablūkum bil-shari wal-khayri fit'natan wa-ilaynā tur'jaʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كل نفس ذائقة الموت ونبلوكم بالشر والخير فتنة وإلينا ترجعون

verse_text_english: When those who disbelieve see you, they ridicule you: "Is this the one who challenges your gods?" Meanwhile, they remain totally heedless of the message from the Most Gracious.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā raāka alladhīna kafarū in yattakhidhūnaka illā huzuwan ahādhā alladhī yadhkuru ālihatakum wahum bidhik'ri l-raḥmāni hum kāfirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا رءاك الذين كفروا إن يتخذونك إلا هزوا أهذا الذى يذكر ءالهتكم وهم بذكر الرحمن هم كفرون

verse_text_english: The human being is impatient by nature. I will inevitably show you My signs; do not be in such a hurry.
verse_text_arabic: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: khuliqa l-insānu min ʿajalin sa-urīkum āyātī falā tastaʿjilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: خلق الإنسن من عجل سأوريكم ءايتى فلا تستعجلون

verse_text_english: They challenge: "Where is that (retribution), if you are truthful?"
verse_text_arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ويقولون متى هذا الوعد إن كنتم صدقين

verse_text_english: If only those who disbelieve could envision themselves when they try to ward off the fire; off their faces and their backs! No one will help them then.
verse_text_arabic: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: law yaʿlamu alladhīna kafarū ḥīna lā yakuffūna ʿan wujūhihimu l-nāra walā ʿan ẓuhūrihim walā hum yunṣarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لو يعلم الذين كفروا حين لا يكفون عن وجوههم النار ولا عن ظهورهم ولا هم ينصرون

verse_text_english: Indeed, it will come to them suddenly, and they will be utterly stunned. They can neither avoid it, nor can they receive any respite.
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: bal tatīhim baghtatan fatabhatuhum falā yastaṭīʿūna raddahā walā hum yunẓarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل تأتيهم بغتة فتبهتهم فلا يستطيعون ردها ولا هم ينظرون

verse_text_english: Messengers before you have been ridiculed, and, consequently, those who ridiculed them incurred the retribution for their ridiculing.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqadi us'tuh'zi-a birusulin min qablika faḥāqa bi-alladhīna sakhirū min'hum mā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد استهزئ برسل من قبلك فحاق بالذين سخروا منهم ما كانوا به يستهزءون

verse_text_english: Say, "Who can protect you from the Most Gracious during the night or during the day?" Indeed, they are totally oblivious to the message of their Lord.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qul man yakla-ukum bi-al-layli wal-nahāri mina l-raḥmāni bal hum ʿan dhik'ri rabbihim muʿ'riḍūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل من يكلؤكم باليل والنهار من الرحمن بل هم عن ذكر ربهم معرضون

verse_text_english: Do they have gods who can protect them from us? They cannot even help themselves. Nor can they accompany one another when they are summoned to face us.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am lahum ālihatun tamnaʿuhum min dūninā lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣra anfusihim walā hum minnā yuṣ'ḥabūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم لهم ءالهة تمنعهم من دوننا لا يستطيعون نصر أنفسهم ولا هم منا يصحبون

verse_text_english: We have provided for these people and their ancestors, up until an old age. Do they not see that every day on earth brings them closer to the end? Can they reverse this process?
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: bal mattaʿnā hāulāi waābāahum ḥattā ṭāla ʿalayhimu l-ʿumuru afalā yarawna annā natī l-arḍa nanquṣuhā min aṭrāfihā afahumu l-ghālibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل متعنا هؤلاء وءاباءهم حتى طال عليهم العمر أفلا يرون أنا نأتى الأرض ننقصها من أطرافها أفهم الغلبون

verse_text_english: Say, "I am warning you in accordance with divine inspiration." However, the deaf cannot hear the call, when they are warned.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qul innamā undhirukum bil-waḥyi walā yasmaʿu l-ṣumu l-duʿāa idhā mā yundharūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل إنما أنذركم بالوحى ولا يسمع الصم الدعاء إذا ما ينذرون

verse_text_english: When a sample of your Lord's retribution afflicts them, they readily say, "We were indeed wicked."
verse_text_arabic: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wala-in massathum nafḥatun min ʿadhābi rabbika layaqūlunna yāwaylanā innā kunnā ẓālimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولئن مستهم نفحة من عذاب ربك ليقولن يويلنا إنا كنا ظلمين

verse_text_english: We will establish the scales of justice on the Day of Resurrection. No soul will suffer the least injustice. Even the equivalent of a mustard seed will be accounted for. We are the most efficient reckoners.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَٰسِبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wanaḍaʿu l-mawāzīna l-qis'ṭa liyawmi l-qiyāmati falā tuẓ'lamu nafsun shayan wa-in kāna mith'qāla ḥabbatin min khardalin ataynā bihā wakafā binā ḥāsibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونضع الموزين القسط ليوم القيمة فلا تظلم نفس شيـٔا وإن كان مثقال حبة من خردل أتينا بها وكفى بنا حسبين

verse_text_english: We gave Moses and Aaron the Statute Book, a beacon, and a reminder for the righteous.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad ātaynā mūsā wahārūna l-fur'qāna waḍiyāan wadhik'ran lil'muttaqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد ءاتينا موسى وهرون الفرقان وضياء وذكرا للمتقين

verse_text_english: The ones who reverence their Lord, even when alone in their privacy, and they worry about the Hour.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wahum mina l-sāʿati mush'fiqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين يخشون ربهم بالغيب وهم من الساعة مشفقون

verse_text_english: This too is a blessed reminder that we sent down. Are you denying it?
verse_text_arabic: وَهَٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wahādhā dhik'run mubārakun anzalnāhu afa-antum lahu munkirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهذا ذكر مبارك أنزلنه أفأنتم له منكرون

verse_text_english: Before that, we granted Abraham his guidance and understanding, for we were fully aware of him.*
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَٰلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad ātaynā ib'rāhīma rush'dahu min qablu wakunnā bihi ʿālimīn
verse_footnote_english: *21:51 Was Abraham so smart as to discover God, or, did God grant him the intelligence because He knew that he deserved to be saved? As it turns out, this whole world was created to redeem those among us who deserve redemption. When the angels suggested that all the rebels, humans and jinns, must be banished out of God's kingdom, 'I know what you do not know' (2:30). At the same time, this world proves Satan's incompetence as a god (App. 7).
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد ءاتينا إبرهيم رشده من قبل وكنا به علمين

verse_text_english: He said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoting yourselves?"
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَٰكِفُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mā hādhihi l-tamāthīlu allatī antum lahā ʿākifūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ قال لأبيه وقومه ما هذه التماثيل التى أنتم لها عكفون

verse_text_english: They said, "We found our parents worshiping them."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَٰبِدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū wajadnā ābāanā lahā ʿābidīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا وجدنا ءاباءنا لها عبدين

verse_text_english: He said, "Indeed, you and your parents have gone totally astray."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla laqad kuntum antum waābāukum fī ḍalālin mubīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال لقد كنتم أنتم وءاباؤكم فى ضلل مبين

verse_text_english: They said, "Are you telling us the truth, or are you playing?"
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّٰعِبِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū aji'tanā bil-ḥaqi am anta mina l-lāʿibīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا أجئتنا بالحق أم أنت من اللعبين

verse_text_english: He said, "Your only Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, who created them. This is the testimony to which I bear witness.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla bal rabbukum rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi alladhī faṭarahunna wa-anā ʿalā dhālikum mina l-shāhidīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال بل ربكم رب السموت والأرض الذى فطرهن وأنا على ذلكم من الشهدين

verse_text_english: "I swear by GOD, I have a plan to deal with your statues, as soon as you leave."
verse_text_arabic: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: watal-lahi la-akīdanna aṣnāmakum baʿda an tuwallū mud'birīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتالله لأكيدن أصنمكم بعد أن تولوا مدبرين

verse_text_english: He broke them into pieces, except for a big one, that they may refer to it.
verse_text_arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fajaʿalahum judhādhan illā kabīran lahum laʿallahum ilayhi yarjiʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فج��لهم جذذا إلا كبيرا لهم لعلهم إليه يرجعون

verse_text_english: They said, "Whoever did this to our gods is really a transgressor."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū man faʿala hādhā biālihatinā innahu lamina l-ẓālimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا من فعل هذا بـٔالهتنا إنه لمن الظلمين

verse_text_english: They said, "We heard a youth threaten them; he is called Abraham."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū samiʿ'nā fatan yadhkuruhum yuqālu lahu ib'rāhīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا سمعنا فتى يذكرهم يقال له إبرهيم

verse_text_english: They said, "Bring him before the eyes of all the people, that they may bear witness."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū fatū bihi ʿalā aʿyuni l-nāsi laʿallahum yashhadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا فأتوا به على أعين الناس لعلهم يشهدون

verse_text_english: They said, "Did you do this to our gods, O Abraham?"
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū a-anta faʿalta hādhā biālihatinā yāib'rāhīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا ءأنت فعلت هذا بـٔالهتنا يإبرهيم

verse_text_english: He said, "It is that big one who did it. Go ask them, if they can speak."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla bal faʿalahu kabīruhum hādhā fasalūhum in kānū yanṭiqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال بل فعله كبيرهم هذا فسـٔلوهم إن كانوا ينطقون

verse_text_english: They were taken aback, and said to themselves, "Indeed, you are the ones who have been transgressing."
verse_text_arabic: فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: farajaʿū ilā anfusihim faqālū innakum antumu l-ẓālimūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فرجعوا إلى أنفسهم فقالوا إنكم أنتم الظلمون

verse_text_english: Yet, they reverted to their old ideas: "You know full well that these cannot speak."
verse_text_arabic: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: thumma nukisū ʿalā ruūsihim laqad ʿalim'ta mā hāulāi yanṭiqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ثم نكسوا على رءوسهم لقد علمت ما هؤلاء ينطقون

verse_text_english: He said, "Do you then worship besides GOD what possesses no power to benefit you or harm you?
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla afataʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿukum shayan walā yaḍurruku
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال أفتعبدون من دون الله ما لا ينفعكم شيـٔا ولا يضركم

verse_text_english: "You have incurred shame by worshiping idols beside GOD. Do you not understand?"
verse_text_arabic: أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: uffin lakum walimā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi afalā taʿqilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أف لكم ولما تعبدون من دون الله أفلا تعقلون

verse_text_english: They said, "Burn him and support your gods, if this is what you decide to do."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū ḥarriqūhu wa-unṣurū ālihatakum in kuntum fāʿilīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا حرقوه وانصروا ءالهتكم إن كنتم فعلين

verse_text_english: We said, "O fire, be cool and safe for Abraham."*
verse_text_arabic: قُلْنَا يَٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًا وَسَلَٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verse_text_transliterated: qul'nā yānāru kūnī bardan wasalāman ʿalā ib'rāhīm
verse_footnote_english: *21:69 "Cool," without "and safe" would have caused Abraham to freeze.
verse_text_arabic_clean: قلنا ينار كونى بردا وسلما على إبرهيم

verse_text_english: Thus, they schemed against him, but we made them the losers.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-arādū bihi kaydan fajaʿalnāhumu l-akhsarīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأرادوا به كيدا فجعلنهم الأخسرين

verse_text_english: We saved him, and we saved Lot, to the land that we blessed for all the people.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wanajjaynāhu walūṭan ilā l-arḍi allatī bāraknā fīhā lil'ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونجينه ولوطا إلى الأرض التى بركنا فيها للعلمين

verse_text_english: And we granted him Isaac and Jacob as a gift, and we made them both righteous.
verse_text_arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَٰلِحِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wawahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba nāfilatan wakullan jaʿalnā ṣāliḥīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ووهبنا له إسحق ويعقوب نافلة وكلا جعلنا صلحين

verse_text_english: We made them imams who guided in accordance with our commandments, and we taught them how to work righteousness, and how to observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat).* To us, they were devoted worshipers.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَٰبِدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿalnāhum a-immatan yahdūna bi-amrinā wa-awḥaynā ilayhim fiʿ'la l-khayrāti wa-iqāma l-ṣalati waītāa l-zakati wakānū lanā ʿābidīn
verse_subtitle_english: Abraham: Delivered All Religious Duties of Submission
verse_footnote_english: *21:73 When the Quran was revealed, all religious duties were already established through Abraham (2:128, 16:123, 22:78).
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعلنهم أئمة يهدون بأمرنا وأوحينا إليهم فعل الخيرت وإقام الصلوة وإيتاء الزكوة وكانوا لنا عبدين

verse_text_english: As for Lot, we granted him wisdom and knowledge, and we saved him from the community that practiced abominations; they were wicked and evil people.
verse_text_arabic: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَٰٓئِثَ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَٰسِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: walūṭan ātaynāhu ḥuk'man waʿil'man wanajjaynāhu mina l-qaryati allatī kānat taʿmalu l-khabāitha innahum kānū qawma sawin fāsiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولوطا ءاتينه حكما وعلما ونجينه من القرية التى كانت تعمل الخبئث إنهم كانوا قوم سوء فسقين

verse_text_english: We admitted him into our mercy, for he was righteous.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-adkhalnāhu fī raḥmatinā innahu mina l-ṣāliḥīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأدخلنه فى رحمتنا إنه من الصلحين

verse_text_english: And, before that, Noah called and we responded to him. We saved him and his family from the great disaster.
verse_text_arabic: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: wanūḥan idh nādā min qablu fa-is'tajabnā lahu fanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu mina l-karbi l-ʿaẓīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونوحا إذ نادى من قبل فاستجبنا له فنجينه وأهله من الكرب العظيم

verse_text_english: We supported him against the people who rejected our revelations. They were evil people, so we drowned them all.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wanaṣarnāhu mina l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā innahum kānū qawma sawin fa-aghraqnāhum ajmaʿīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونصرنه من القوم الذين كذبوا بـٔايتنا إنهم كانوا قوم سوء فأغرقنهم أجمعين

verse_text_english: And David and Solomon, when they once ruled with regard to someone's crop that was destroyed by another's sheep. We witnessed their judgment.
verse_text_arabic: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَٰهِدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wadāwūda wasulaymāna idh yaḥkumāni fī l-ḥarthi idh nafashat fīhi ghanamu l-qawmi wakunnā liḥuk'mihim shāhidīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وداود وسليمن إذ يحكمان فى الحرث إذ نفشت فيه غنم القوم وكنا لحكمهم شهدين

verse_text_english: We granted Solomon the correct understanding, though we endowed both of them with wisdom and knowledge. We committed the mountains to serve David in glorifying (GOD), as well as the birds. This is what we did.
verse_text_arabic: فَفَهَّمْنَٰهَا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ وَكُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fafahhamnāhā sulaymāna wakullan ātaynā ḥuk'man waʿil'man wasakharnā maʿa dāwūda l-jibāla yusabbiḥ'na wal-ṭayra wakunnā fāʿilīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ففهمنها سليمن وكلا ءاتينا حكما وعلما وسخرنا مع داود الجبال يسبحن والطير وكنا فعلين

verse_text_english: And we taught him the skill of making shields to protect you in war. Are you then thankful?
verse_text_arabic: وَعَلَّمْنَٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَٰكِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: waʿallamnāhu ṣanʿata labūsin lakum lituḥ'ṣinakum min basikum fahal antum shākirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وعلمنه صنعة لبوس لكم لتحصنكم من بأسكم فهل أنتم شكرون

verse_text_english: For Solomon, we committed the wind gusting and blowing at his disposal. He could direct it as he wished, to whatever land he chose, and we blessed such land for him. We are fully aware of all things.
verse_text_arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَٰلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: walisulaymāna l-rīḥa ʿāṣifatan tajrī bi-amrihi ilā l-arḍi allatī bāraknā fīhā wakunnā bikulli shayin ʿālimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولسليمن الريح عاصفة تجرى بأمره إلى الأرض التى بركنا فيها وكنا بكل شىء علمين

verse_text_english: And of the devils there were those who would dive for him (to harvest the sea), or do whatever else he commanded them to do. We committed them in his service.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamina l-shayāṭīni man yaghūṣūna lahu wayaʿmalūna ʿamalan dūna dhālika wakunnā lahum ḥāfiẓīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن الشيطين من يغوصون له ويعملون عملا دون ذلك وكنا لهم حفظين

verse_text_english: And Job implored his Lord: "Adversity has befallen me, and, of all the merciful ones, You are the Most Merciful."
verse_text_arabic: وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya l-ḍuru wa-anta arḥamu l-rāḥimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأيوب إذ نادى ربه أنى مسنى الضر وأنت أرحم الرحمين

verse_text_english: We responded to him, relieved his adversity, and restored his family for him, even twice as much. That was a mercy from us, and a reminder for the worshipers.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَٰبِدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-is'tajabnā lahu fakashafnā mā bihi min ḍurrin waātaynāhu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatan min ʿindinā wadhik'rā lil'ʿābidīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاستجبنا له فكشفنا ما به من ضر وءاتينه أهله ومثلهم معهم رحمة من عندنا وذكرى للعبدين

verse_text_english: Also, Ismail, Idrîs, Zal-Kifl; all were steadfast, patient.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-is'māʿīla wa-id'rīsa wadhā l-kif'li kullun mina l-ṣābirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإسمعيل وإدريس وذا الكفل كل من الصبرين

verse_text_english: We admitted them into our mercy, for they were righteous.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-adkhalnāhum fī raḥmatinā innahum mina l-ṣāliḥīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأدخلنهم فى رحمتنا إنهم من الصلحين

verse_text_english: And Zan-Noon (Jonah, "the one with an 'N' in his name"), abandoned his mission in protest, thinking that we could not control him. He ended up imploring from the darkness (of the big fish's belly): "There is no god other than You. Be You glorified. I have committed a gross sin."
verse_text_arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wadhā l-nūni idh dhahaba mughāḍiban faẓanna an lan naqdira ʿalayhi fanādā fī l-ẓulumāti an lā ilāha illā anta sub'ḥānaka innī kuntu mina l-ẓālimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وذا النون إذ ذهب مغضبا فظن أن لن نقدر عليه فنادى فى الظلمت أن لا إله إلا أنت سبحنك إنى كنت من الظلمين

verse_text_english: We responded to him, and saved him from the crisis; we thus save the believers.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-is'tajabnā lahu wanajjaynāhu mina l-ghami wakadhālika nunjī l-mu'minīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاستجبنا له ونجينه من الغم وكذلك نجى المؤمنين

verse_text_english: And Zachariah implored his Lord: "My Lord, do not keep me without an heir, though You are the best inheritor."
verse_text_arabic: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wazakariyyā idh nādā rabbahu rabbi lā tadharnī fardan wa-anta khayru l-wārithīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وزكريا إذ نادى ربه رب لا تذرنى فردا وأنت خير الورثين

verse_text_english: We* responded to him and granted him John; we fixed his wife for him. That is because they used to hasten to work righteousness, and implored us in situations of joy, as well as fear. To us, they were reverent.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُۥ زَوْجَهُۥٓ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا خَٰشِعِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-is'tajabnā lahu wawahabnā lahu yaḥyā wa-aṣlaḥnā lahu zawjahu innahum kānū yusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wayadʿūnanā raghaban warahaban wakānū lanā khāshiʿīn
verse_footnote_english: *21:90 The use of the plural tense throughout the Quran indicates participation of the angels. It is clear from 3:39 and from the Bible that the angels dealt with Zachariah extensively, as they gave him the good news about John. See Appendix 10.
verse_text_arabic_clean: فاستجبنا له ووهبنا له يحيى وأصلحنا له زوجه إنهم كانوا يسرعون فى الخيرت ويدعوننا رغبا ورهبا وكانوا لنا خشعين

verse_text_english: As for the one who maintained her virginity, we blew into her from our spirit, and thus, we made her and her son a portent for the whole world.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا وَٱبْنَهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-allatī aḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhā min rūḥinā wajaʿalnāhā wa-ib'nahā āyatan lil'ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والتى أحصنت فرجها فنفخنا فيها من روحنا وجعلنها وابنها ءاية للعلمين

verse_text_english: Your congregation is but one congregation, and I alone am your Lord; you shall worship Me alone.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: inna hādhihi ummatukum ummatan wāḥidatan wa-anā rabbukum fa-uʿ'budūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هذه أمتكم أمة وحدة وأنا ربكم فاعبدون

verse_text_english: However, they divided themselves into disputing religions. All of them will come back to us (for judgment).
verse_text_arabic: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum kullun ilaynā rājiʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتقطعوا أمرهم بينهم كل إلينا رجعون

verse_text_english: As for those who work righteousness, while believing, their work will not go to waste; we are recording it.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَٰتِبُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: faman yaʿmal mina l-ṣāliḥāti wahuwa mu'minun falā kuf'rāna lisaʿyihi wa-innā lahu kātibūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فمن يعمل من الصلحت وهو مؤمن فلا كفران لسعيه وإنا له كتبون

verse_text_english: It is forbidden for any community we had annihilated to return.
verse_text_arabic: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: waḥarāmun ʿalā qaryatin ahlaknāhā annahum lā yarjiʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وحرم على قرية أهلكنها أنهم لا يرجعون

verse_text_english: Not until Gog and Magog reappear,* will they then return—they will come from every direction.
verse_text_arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنسِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: ḥattā idhā futiḥat yajūju wamajūju wahum min kulli ḥadabin yansilūn
verse_footnote_english: *21:96 By the year 2270 AD, thanks to God's mathematical miracle in the Quran (Appendix 1), America will be the heart of Submission, and billions around the globe will have believed in the Quran (9:33, 41:53, 48:28, 61:9). Gog and Magog (allegorical names of villainous communities), will be the only bastions of heathenism, and they will attack the submitters. That is when the world will end (15:87, 18:94, Appendix 25). Gog and Magog are mentioned in 18:94 & 21:96, 17 verses before the end of each sura; this may indicate the time of their appearance.
verse_text_arabic_clean: حتى إذا فتحت يأجوج ومأجوج وهم من كل حدب ينسلون

verse_text_english: That is when the inevitable prophecy will come to pass, and the disbelievers will stare in horror: "Woe to us; we have been oblivious. Indeed, we have been wicked."
verse_text_arabic: وَٱقْتَرَبَ ٱلْوَعْدُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِىَ شَٰخِصَةٌ أَبْصَٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-iq'taraba l-waʿdu l-ḥaqu fa-idhā hiya shākhiṣatun abṣāru alladhīna kafarū yāwaylanā qad kunnā fī ghaflatin min hādhā bal kunnā ẓālimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: واقترب الوعد الحق فإذا هى شخصة أبصر الذين كفروا يويلنا قد كنا فى غفلة من هذا بل كنا ظلمين

verse_text_english: You and the idols you worship besides GOD will be fuel for Hell; this is your inevitable destiny.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: innakum wamā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi ḥaṣabu jahannama antum lahā wāridūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنكم وما تعبدون من دون الله حصب جهنم أنتم لها وردون

verse_text_english: If those were gods, they would not have ended up in Hell. All its inhabitants abide in it forever.
verse_text_arabic: لَوْ كَانَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوهَا وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: law kāna hāulāi ālihatan mā waradūhā wakullun fīhā khālidūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لو كان هؤلاء ءالهة ما وردوها وكل فيها خلدون

verse_text_english: They will sigh and groan therein, and they will have no access to any news.
verse_text_arabic: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lahum fīhā zafīrun wahum fīhā lā yasmaʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لهم فيها زفير وهم فيها لا يسمعون

verse_text_english: As for those who deserved our magnificent rewards, they will be protected from it.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: inna alladhīna sabaqat lahum minnā l-ḥus'nā ulāika ʿanhā mub'ʿadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الذين سبقت لهم منا الحسنى أولئك عنها مبعدون

verse_text_english: They will not hear its hissing. They will enjoy an abode where they can get everything they desire, forever.
verse_text_arabic: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا وَهُمْ فِى مَا ٱشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَٰلِدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lā yasmaʿūna ḥasīsahā wahum fī mā ish'tahat anfusuhum khālidūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يسمعون حسيسها وهم فى ما اشتهت أنفسهم خلدون

verse_text_english: The great horror will not worry them, and the angels will receive them joyfully: "This is your day, that has been promised to you."
verse_text_arabic: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ ٱلْفَزَعُ ٱلْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ هَٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: lā yaḥzunuhumu l-fazaʿu l-akbaru watatalaqqāhumu l-malāikatu hādhā yawmukumu alladhī kuntum tūʿadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لا يحزنهم الفزع الأكبر وتتلقىهم الملئكة هذا يومكم الذى كنتم توعدون

verse_text_english: On that day, we will fold the heaven, like the folding of a book. Just as we initiated the first creation, we will repeat it. This is our promise; we will certainly carry it out.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِيدُهُۥ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma naṭwī l-samāa kaṭayyi l-sijili lil'kutubi kamā badanā awwala khalqin nuʿīduhu waʿdan ʿalaynā innā kunnā fāʿilīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم نطوى السماء كطى السجل للكتب كما بدأنا أول خلق نعيده وعدا علينا إنا كنا فعلين

verse_text_english: We have decreed in the Psalms, as well as in other scriptures, that the earth shall be inherited by My righteous worshipers.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلذِّكْرِ أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad katabnā fī l-zabūri min baʿdi l-dhik'ri anna l-arḍa yarithuhā ʿibādiya l-ṣāliḥūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد كتبنا فى الزبور من بعد الذكر أن الأرض يرثها عبادى الصلحون

verse_text_english: This is a proclamation for people who are worshipers.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ فِى هَٰذَا لَبَلَٰغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عَٰبِدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: inna fī hādhā labalāghan liqawmin ʿābidīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن فى هذا لبلغا لقوم عبدين

verse_text_english: We have sent you out of mercy from us towards the whole world.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā arsalnāka illā raḥmatan lil'ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أرسلنك إلا رحمة للعلمين

verse_text_english: Proclaim, "I have been given divine inspiration that your god is one god. Will you then submit?"
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qul innamā yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fahal antum mus'limūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل إنما يوحى إلى أنما إلهكم إله وحد فهل أنتم مسلمون

verse_text_english: If they turn away, then say, "I have warned you sufficiently, and I have no idea how soon or late (the retribution) will come to you.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-in tawallaw faqul ādhantukum ʿalā sawāin wa-in adrī aqarībun am baʿīdun mā tūʿadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإن تولوا فقل ءاذنتكم على سواء وإن أدرى أقريب أم بعيد ما توعدون

verse_text_english: "He is fully aware of your public utterances, and He is fully aware of everything you conceal.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: innahu yaʿlamu l-jahra mina l-qawli wayaʿlamu mā taktumūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنه يعلم الجهر من القول ويعلم ما تكتمون

verse_text_english: "For all that I know, this world is a test for you, and a temporary enjoyment."
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةٌ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-in adrī laʿallahu fit'natun lakum wamatāʿun ilā ḥīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن أدرى لعله فتنة لكم ومتع إلى حين

verse_text_english: Say, "My Lord, Your judgment is the absolute justice. Our Lord is the Most Gracious; only His help is sought in the face of your claims."
verse_text_arabic: قَٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi uḥ'kum bil-ḥaqi warabbunā l-raḥmānu l-mus'taʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل رب احكم بالحق وربنا الرحمن المستعان على ما تصفون
